tunables.label: Server Port
tunables.description: Internal unprivileged container listening port for Python web servers (Uvicorn / Gunicorn / Flask / Django).
tunables.troubleshooting: Platform Python base images listen on unprivileged port 8080.

tunables.label: Unbuffered Logs
tunables.description: Forces standard output and error streams to be unbuffered so logs stream in real-time.
tunables.troubleshooting: Keep set to '1' to prevent log delivery delays in Kubernetes and Docker logs.

tunables.label: Disable Bytecode (.pyc)
tunables.description: Prevents Python from writing .pyc files on disk, ensuring container immutability.
tunables.troubleshooting: Recommended for ephemeral containers and read-only root filesystems.

tunables.label: ASGI / WSGI Workers
tunables.description: Number of parallel worker processes for Gunicorn and Uvicorn runners.
tunables.troubleshooting: Tune according to container CPU limit (typically (2 x CPU cores) + 1).
